title: DwC withholding-terms stamping hard invariant + taxon-as-quasi-identifier (l-diversity) in @csp/privacy
context: PLAN v0.2 adds two new hard invariants not covered by csp-privacy-009 or csp-privacy-010. First: every generalized record must stamp dwc:dataGeneralizations / dwc:informationWithheld and the TDWG Sensitive Species Extension fields so a generalized record is downstream-distinguishable from a precise one (never silently indistinguishable). Second: for a sensitive taxon the taxon itself is a quasi-identifier of location, so suppression must weigh the species attribute (l-diversity-style), not only the coordinate. The plan adds a Withholding disclosure hard invariant metric (100%) and a new risk row for this gap. The mandatory reviewer gate must confirm 100% of generalized records carry withholding terms. Depends on csp-privacy-009 and csp-privacy-010.
objective: Extend @csp/privacy to stamp standard DwC withholding terms (dwc:dataGeneralizations, dwc:informationWithheld, TDWG Sensitive Species Extension) on every generalized record, add a hard invariant test asserting 100% coverage, and implement taxon-as-quasi-identifier (l-diversity-style) suppression so that a sensitive taxon triggers coordinate generalization regardless of coordinate precision.
acceptanceCriteria: Every generalized record in @csp/privacy output carries dwc:dataGeneralizations and dwc:informationWithheld stamped with the fact and method of withholding; TDWG Sensitive Species Extension fields populated where applicable
Hard invariant test in CI: 100% of generalized records carry withholding terms; CI fails if any generalized record lacks them (zero silent generalizations)
Taxon-as-quasi-identifier (l-diversity-style) check implemented: a sensitive taxon triggers coordinate generalization even when coordinate precision is within the default threshold
PrivacyRule schema updated to include withholding subfields (dataGeneralizations, informationWithheld, sensitiveSpeciesExtensionFields) per the v0.2 data model
No real PII or sensitive-taxa coordinates committed to repo or CI fixtures; sign-off gate artifact references expert review per csp-privacy-010
output: A PR extending @csp/privacy with withholding-terms stamping on every generalized record, the hard invariant CI test, and taxon-as-quasi-identifier suppression logic.
